children: Switzerland’s current account surplus widened to CHF 23.7 billion in the second quarter of 2026 from a downwardly revised CHF 10.2 billion in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

This marked the largest surplus since the first quarter of 2025, as the goods account surplus increased to CHF 29.7 billion from CHF 17.1 billion, while the primary income account swung to a surplus of CHF 0.3 billion from a deficit of CHF 1.7 billion, largely driven by higher investment income of CHF 8.3 billion from CHF 6.5 billion, while the labour income deficit remained unchanged at CHF 8.2 billion.
Additionally, the secondary income deficit narrowed to CHF 1.7 billion from CHF 2.9 billion a year earlier.
On the other hand, the services account deficit widened to CHF 4.4 billion from CHF 2.2 billion.

title: Switzerland Current Account Surplus Hits 1-Year High
